# Linear regression power calculation: Test R² = 0
# Parameters
n <- 80                      # sample size (participants)
k <- 3                       # number of predictors
rho <- 0.30                  # anticipated multiple correlation
alpha <- 0.05                # significance level (one-sided, upper tail)

# Compute R² from multiple correlation
R_squared <- rho^2
cat("R² (anticipated):", R_squared, "\n")

# Degrees of freedom
df_num <- k                           # numerator df = number of predictors
df_denom <- n - k - 1                # denominator df = n - k - 1
cat("Degrees of freedom: numerator =", df_num, ", denominator =", df_denom, "\n")

# Noncentrality parameter λ
# λ = F_stat × df_denom
# where F_stat = [R²/(1 - R²)] × (df_denom / df_num)
F_stat <- (R_squared / (1 - R_squared)) * (df_denom / df_num)
lambda <- F_stat * df_denom
cat("F-statistic (under H1):", F_stat, "\n")
cat("Noncentrality parameter λ:", lambda, "\n")

# Critical value from central F distribution at α = 0.05 (upper tail)
F_crit <- qf(1 - alpha, df1 = df_num, df2 = df_denom)
cat("Critical F-value (α =", alpha, "):", F_crit, "\n")

# Power: P(F > F_crit | H1)
# Under H1, F follows a noncentral F distribution with noncentrality parameter λ
power <- 1 - pf(F_crit, df1 = df_num, df2 = df_denom, ncp = lambda)
cat("\nPower:", power, "\n")

# Summary
cat("\n=== Summary ===\n")
cat("Sample size:", n, "participants\n")
cat("Number of predictors:", k, "\n")
cat("Multiple correlation (ρ):", rho, "\n")
cat("R² (H1):", R_squared, "\n")
cat("Hypothesis: H0: R² = 0 vs H1: R² > 0 (one-sided, upper tail)\n")
cat("Significance level (α):", alpha, "\n")
cat("Power:", round(power, 6), "\n")

# Return result in required format
results <- list(
  metric = "power",
  value = power,
  unit = "probability"
)

cat("Input parameters:\n")
cat("  n =", n, "participants\n")
cat("  k =", k, "predictors\n")
cat("  ρ (multiple correlation) =", rho, "\n")

cat("Degrees of freedom:\n")
cat("  df₁ (numerator) =", df1, "\n")
cat("  df₂ (denominator) = n - k - 1 =", n, "-", k, "- 1 =", df2, "\n\n")

# Critical value from the central F distribution (H₀ distribution)
F_crit <- qf(p = 1 - alpha, df1 = df1, df2 = df2, lower.tail = TRUE)
cat("Critical F-value from F(df₁=", df1, ", df₂=", df2, "):\n")
cat("  F_crit = F_{1-α}(", df1, ",", df2, ") = F_{0.95}(", df1, ",", df2, ") =", F_crit, "\n\n")

# Noncentrality parameter

# This is the standard parameterization in R's noncentral F functions
lambda <- n * R_sq / (1 - R_sq)
cat("Noncentrality parameter (H1):\n")
cat("  λ = n × R² / (1 - R²)\n")
cat("    = ", n, "×", R_sq, "/", (1 - R_sq), "\n")
cat("    =", lambda, "\n\n")

# Linear regression power calculation: Test R² = 0
# Parameters
n <- 80                      # sample size (participants)
k <- 3                       # number of predictors
rho <- 0.30                  # anticipated multiple correlation
alpha <- 0.05                # significance level (one-sided, upper tail)

# Compute R² from multiple correlation
R_squared <- rho^2
cat("R² (anticipated):", R_squared, "\n")

# Degrees of freedom
df_num <- k                           # numerator df = number of predictors
df_denom <- n - k - 1                # denominator df = n - k - 1
cat("Degrees of freedom: numerator =", df_num, ", denominator =", df_denom, "\n")

# Noncentrality parameter λ
# λ = F_stat × df_denom
# where F_stat = [R²/(1 - R²)] × (df_denom / df_num)
F_stat <- (R_squared / (1 - R_squared)) * (df_denom / df_num)
lambda <- F_stat * df_denom
cat("F-statistic (under H1):", F_stat, "\n")
cat("Noncentrality parameter λ:", lambda, "\n")

# Critical value from central F distribution at α = 0.05 (upper tail)
F_crit <- qf(1 - alpha, df1 = df_num, df2 = df_denom)
cat("Critical F-value (α =", alpha, "):", F_crit, "\n")

# Power: P(F > F_crit | H1)
# Under H1, F follows a noncentral F distribution with noncentrality parameter λ
power <- 1 - pf(F_crit, df1 = df_num, df2 = df_denom, ncp = lambda)
cat("\nPower:", power, "\n")

# Summary
cat("\n=== Summary ===\n")
cat("Sample size:", n, "participants\n")
cat("Number of predictors:", k, "\n")
cat("Multiple correlation (ρ):", rho, "\n")
cat("R² (H1):", R_squared, "\n")
cat("Hypothesis: H0: R² = 0 vs H1: R² > 0 (one-sided, upper tail)\n")
cat("Significance level (α):", alpha, "\n")
cat("Power:", round(power, 6), "\n")

# Return result in required format
results <- list(
  metric = "power",
  value = power,
  unit = "probability"
)

cat("\nPOWER_AGENT_RESULT=", jsonlite::toJSON(list(results = list(results)), auto_unbox = TRUE, digits = 15), "\n", sep = "")

alpha <- 0.05        # significance level

df1 <- k             # numerator df = number of predictors
df2 <- n - k - 1     # denominator df = n - k - 1

cat("=== Independent Verification ===\n")

cat("  n =", n, ", k =", k, ", ρ =", rho, ", α =", alpha, "\n")
cat("  R² =", R_sq, "\n")
cat("  df1 =", df1, ", df2 =", df2, "\n\n")

cat("Critical F-value (upper 0.05 tail of F(3,76)):\n")
cat("  F_crit =", F_crit, "\n\n")

# Correct noncentrality parameter formula
# The noncentrality parameter for the F-test of global R² is:
# λ = n * R² / (1 - R²)
# This comes from the fact that the test statistic under H1 is:
# F = [R²/(1-R²)] * [(n-k-1)/k] ~ F(k, n-k-1; λ)
# where λ = n * R² / (1 - R²)

lambda <- n * R_sq / (1 - R_sq)
cat("Noncentrality parameter (correct formula):\n")
cat("  λ = n * R² / (1 - R²)\n")
cat("  λ =", n, "*", R_sq, "/", (1 - R_sq), "\n")

# The noncentrality parameter λ for a noncentral F distribution is defined such that:
# If X ~ F(df1, df2; λ), then E[X] = (df2 / (df2 - 2)) * (1 + λ / df1)
# for df2 > 2

# For the R² test specifically:
# Under H1 with true R² = ρ², the noncentrality parameter is:
# λ = n * ρ² / (1 - ρ²)

# This can be verified from the expectation of the test statistic:
# E[F | H1] = (ρ² / (1 - ρ²)) * ((n - k - 1) / k)

# And the relationship: E[F(df1, df2; λ)] = (df2/(df2-2)) * (1 + λ/df1)
# So: (ρ² / (1 - ρ²)) * ((n - k - 1) / k) = (df2/(df2-2)) * (1 + λ/df1)
#
# Solving for λ (approximately for moderate df2):
# λ ≈ df1 * [(ρ² / (1 - ρ²)) * ((n - k - 1) / k) - (df2/(df2-2))]

df2 <- n - k - 1

cat("R² (anticipated):", R_squared, "\n")

# Degrees of freedom
df_num <- k                           # numerator df = number of predictors
df_denom <- n - k - 1                # denominator df = n - k - 1
cat("Degrees of freedom: numerator =", df_num, ", denominator =", df_denom, "\n")

# Noncentrality parameter λ
# λ = F_stat × df_denom
# where F_stat = [R²/(1 - R²)] × (df_denom / df_num)
F_stat <- (R_squared / (1 - R_squared)) * (df_denom / df_num)
lambda <- F_stat * df_denom
cat("F-statistic (under H1):", F_stat, "\n")
cat("Noncentrality parameter λ:", lambda, "\n")

# Critical value from central F distribution at α = 0.05 (upper tail)
F_crit <- qf(1 - alpha, df1 = df_num, df2 = df_denom)
cat("Critical F-value (α =", alpha, "):", F_crit, "\n")

# Power: P(F > F_crit | H1)
# Under H1, F follows a noncentral F distribution with noncentrality parameter λ
power <- 1 - pf(F_crit, df1 = df_num, df2 = df_denom, ncp = lambda)
cat("\nPower:", power, "\n")

# Summary
cat("\n=== Summary ===\n")
cat("Sample size:", n, "participants\n")
cat("Number of predictors:", k, "\n")
cat("Multiple correlation (ρ):", rho, "\n")
cat("R² (H1):", R_squared, "\n")
cat("Hypothesis: H0: R² = 0 vs H1: R² > 0 (one-sided, upper tail)\n")
cat("Significance level (α):", alpha, "\n")
cat("Power:", round(power, 6), "\n")

  metric = "power",
  value = power,
  unit = "probability"
)
